row: Dr. Cassie PT - Helping Children Grow

Hi! I’m Dr. Cassie — a physical therapist, founder of Children’s Therapy Network Inc., wife, and mom. This channel supports families raising children with special needs through fun, educational, and practical videos.

With nearly 30 years of experience and a deep love for this community, I’m here to help make life a little easier and a lot more joyful. From activities to expert insights, you'll find resources to empower families and professionals alike.

For a deeper dive, visit drcassie.org for certification and CEU classes for therapists, plus practical, informative content for parents.

My husband, Tom, a recreation therapist, and I are passionate about making a positive impact. Subscribe to join our community as we learn, grow, and make a difference together!
